answer.proof:
have h : i * (2 - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := by
    calc
      i * (2 - Complex.I) = i * z := by rw [h₂]
      _ = v := h₀.symm
      _ = 1 + Complex.I := h₁
  have hc : (1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I) * (2 - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := by
    norm_num [Complex.I_mul_I]
    ring
  have hmul : (i - (1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I)) * (2 - Complex.I) = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = i * (2 - Complex.I) - (1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I) * (2 - Complex.I) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h, hc]; ring
  have hz : (2 : ℂ) - Complex.I ≠ 0 := by
    norm_num
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with hi | hz0
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hi
  · exact (hz hz0).elim
